caption:
Goat curry cut ₹549 in Hyderabad, never frozen: Hyderabadi mutton dalcha in a pressure cooker 🐐🍲 మటన్ దాల్చా
💬 Dalcha with rice or with roti? 👇

Save this Saturday recipe 👇
🛒 You need: 500 g goat curry cut with bone · ½ cup chana dal, soaked · 300 g bottle gourd (sorakaya), cubed · 2 onions · 2 tomatoes · 2 green chillies · curry leaves · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 2 tsp red chilli powder · 1 tsp garam masala · tamarind, soaked · salt · 3 tbsp oil
1️⃣ Cook the mutton with turmeric, salt and 1½ cups water, 5 whistles.
2️⃣ Cook the dal with the bottle gourd, 2 whistles; mash lightly.
3️⃣ Fry onions, chillies, curry leaves; add ginger-garlic, tomatoes, chilli powder.
4️⃣ Add the mutton with its stock and the dal; simmer 10 min.
5️⃣ Add tamarind water and garam masala, simmer 5 min, finish with coriander.
